japanese: よく分かりません。
kana: よく わかりません。
literalMeaning: I don't understand well.
usageNote: A safe, natural way to say you do not understand.

japanese: もう一度言っていただけますか？
kana: もう いちど いって いただけますか？
naturalMeaning: Could you say that one more time?
literalMeaning: Could I have you say it once more?
usageNote: Polite and useful with staff, strangers, or in formal situations.

japanese: もう少しゆっくり話していただけますか？
kana: もう すこし ゆっくり はなして いただけますか？
romaji: mou sukoshi yukkuri hanashite itadakemasu ka?
naturalMeaning: Could you speak a little more slowly?
literalMeaning: Could I have you speak a little more slowly?
usageNote: Natural when asking someone to slow down their Japanese.

english: I only speak a little Japanese.
patterns: i only speak a little japanese
japanese: 日本語は少しだけ話せます。
kana: にほんごは すこしだけ はなせます。
naturalMeaning: I can only speak a little Japanese.
literalMeaning: As for Japanese, I can speak only a little.
usageNote: A friendly way to set expectations without sounding overly negative.

japanese: 助けていただいて、ありがとうございます。
kana: たすけて いただいて、ありがとうございます。
naturalMeaning: Thank you very much for helping me.
literalMeaning: Thank you for having helped me.
usageNote: Warm and polite when someone has helped you.

japanese: 一番近い駅はどこですか？
kana: いちばん ちかい えきは どこですか？
romaji: ichiban chikai eki wa doko desu ka?
literalMeaning: Where is the station that is closest?
usageNote: Useful when asking for the closest railway or subway station.

patterns: what is the best way to get there
japanese: そこへはどうやって行けばいいですか？
kana: そこへは どうやって いけば いいですか？
romaji: soko e wa dou yatte ikeba ii desu ka?
literalMeaning: How would it be good to go there?
usageNote: General-purpose question for asking how to reach a place.

patterns: am i going the right way
japanese: この道で合っていますか？
kana: この みちで あっていますか？
romaji: kono michi de atte imasu ka?
literalMeaning: Is it correct with this road/route?
usageNote: Natural when confirming that you are heading in the correct direction.

japanese: ここまでお願いします。
kana: ここまで おねがいします。
literalMeaning: Up to here, please.
usageNote: Very useful in a taxi while showing the destination on your phone.

english: Does this train go to this station?
patterns: does this train go to this station
will this train take me to this station
japanese: この電車はこの駅に行きますか？
kana: この でんしゃは この えきに いきますか？
romaji: kono densha wa kono eki ni ikimasu ka?
naturalMeaning: Does this train go to this station?
literalMeaning: Does this train go to this station?
usageNote: Show the station name on your phone while asking.

japanese: 何番ホームですか？
kana: なんばん ホームですか？
literalMeaning: What-number platform is it?
usageNote: A concise, natural station question.

patterns: do i have to change trains
japanese: 乗り換えは必要ですか？
kana: のりかえは ひつようですか？
literalMeaning: Is a transfer necessary?
usageNote: Use this to confirm whether you can stay on the same train.

english: What time is the last train?
patterns: what time is the last train
japanese: 終電は何時ですか？
kana: しゅうでんは なんじですか？
naturalMeaning: What time is the last train?
literalMeaning: What time is the last train?
usageNote: 終電 (shuuden) is the standard word for the last train of the day.

english: Could you keep my luggage until check-in?
patterns: could you keep my luggage until check in
can you keep my luggage until check in
leave my luggage until check in
store my luggage before check in
hold my bags until check in
japanese: チェックインまで荷物を預かってもらえますか？
kana: チェックインまで にもつを あずかって もらえますか？
romaji: chekku-in made nimotsu o azukatte moraemasu ka?
naturalMeaning: Could you keep my luggage until check-in?
literalMeaning: Could I have you look after my luggage until check-in?
usageNote: Natural at a hotel front desk. 預かる is commonly used for temporarily holding belongings.

english: Could you keep my luggage until check-in?
patterns: could you keep my luggage until check in
can you store my luggage before check in
would you keep my bags until check in
japanese: チェックインまで荷物を預かっていただけますか？
kana: チェックインまで にもつを あずかって いただけますか？
romaji: chekku-in made nimotsu o azukatte itadakemasu ka?
naturalMeaning: Could you keep my luggage until check-in?
literalMeaning: Could I have you look after my luggage until check-in?
usageNote: A slightly more formal version, suitable for hotel staff.

english: Could you keep my luggage after check-out?
patterns: could you keep my luggage after check out
japanese: チェックアウト後も荷物を預かってもらえますか？
kana: チェックアウトごも にもつを あずかって もらえますか？
romaji: chekku-auto go mo nimotsu o azukatte moraemasu ka?
naturalMeaning: Could you keep my luggage after check-out too?
literalMeaning: Could I have you look after my luggage even after check-out?
usageNote: Natural when asking the hotel to hold luggage after you check out.

japanese: 早めにチェックインできますか？
kana: はやめに チェックイン できますか？
literalMeaning: Is it possible to check in early?
usageNote: A straightforward way to ask about early check-in.

japanese: Wi-Fiのパスワードは何ですか？
kana: ワイファイの パスワードは なんですか？
romaji: waifai no pasuwaado wa nan desu ka?
literalMeaning: What is the Wi-Fi password?
usageNote: Suitable at hotels, cafés, or other venues.

japanese: 二人です。
kana: ふたりです。
literalMeaning: We are two people.
usageNote: At a restaurant entrance, simply saying the number of people is natural.

japanese: おすすめは何ですか？
kana: おすすめは なんですか？
literalMeaning: What is the recommendation?
usageNote: Very common and natural at restaurants and cafés.

japanese: 玉ねぎ抜きでお願いします。
kana: たまねぎ ぬきで おねがいします。
literalMeaning: Please make it without onions.
usageNote: 〜抜き means leaving an ingredient out.

japanese: 食べ物のアレルギーがあります。
kana: たべものの アレルギーが あります。
literalMeaning: There is a food allergy (for me).
usageNote: Follow this with the specific allergen whenever possible.

japanese: お会計をお願いします。
kana: おかいけいを おねがいします。
literalMeaning: The payment/check, please.
usageNote: Standard polite phrase when you are ready to pay.

japanese: 持ち帰りでお願いします。
kana: もちかえりで おねがいします。
literalMeaning: Please make it for taking home.
usageNote: 持ち帰り is a standard way to say takeout.

japanese: 砂糖なしでお願いします。
kana: さとう なしで おねがいします。
literalMeaning: Please make it without sugar.
usageNote: Simple and clear when ordering a drink.

japanese: カードで払えますか？
kana: カードで はらえますか？
literalMeaning: Can I pay with a card?
usageNote: Natural when checking whether card payment is accepted.

japanese: これは免税になりますか？
kana: これは めんぜいに なりますか？
romaji: kore wa menzei ni narimasu ka?
naturalMeaning: Is this eligible for tax-free shopping?
literalMeaning: Does this become tax-exempt?
usageNote: Useful when asking whether an item or purchase qualifies for tax-free shopping.

japanese: これを試着してもいいですか？
kana: これを しちゃくしても いいですか？
romaji: kore o shichaku shite mo ii desu ka?
literalMeaning: Is it okay if I try this on?
usageNote: 試着 is used for trying on clothes.

japanese: 別のサイズはありますか？
kana: べつの サイズは ありますか？
romaji: betsu no saizu wa arimasu ka?
literalMeaning: Is there a different size?
usageNote: Useful for clothing, shoes, and similar items.

patterns: where is the check in counter
japanese: チェックインカウンターはどこですか？
kana: チェックイン カウンターは どこですか？
romaji: chekku-in kauntaa wa doko desu ka?
literalMeaning: Where is the check-in counter?
usageNote: Use this when looking for your airline's counter.

patterns: how do i get to this gate
japanese: この搭乗口はどこですか？
kana: この とうじょうぐちは どこですか？
romaji: kono toujouguchi wa doko desu ka?
literalMeaning: Where is this boarding entrance?
usageNote: Show the gate number on your boarding pass while asking.

patterns: where do i pick up my luggage
japanese: 手荷物受取所はどこですか？
kana: てにもつ うけとりじょは どこですか？
romaji: tenimotsu uketorijo wa doko desu ka?
literalMeaning: Where is the baggage receiving area?
usageNote: Useful after arrival when looking for the baggage carousel area.

japanese: 締め切りを確認していただけますか？
kana: しめきりを かくにんして いただけますか？
romaji: shimekiri o kakunin shite itadakemasu ka?
literalMeaning: Could I have you confirm the deadline?
usageNote: Appropriate for a polite workplace request.

patterns: i'll send this in an email
japanese: メールで送ります。
kana: メールで おくります。
literalMeaning: I will send it by email.
usageNote: Simple, standard workplace Japanese.

english: I'm sorry, I'll be a little late.
patterns: i will be a little late
japanese: すみません、少し遅れます。
kana: すみません、すこし おくれます。
naturalMeaning: I'm sorry, I'll be a little late.
literalMeaning: Excuse me, I will be a little late.
usageNote: Natural for notifying someone that you will arrive late.

japanese: 今どこ？
kana: いま どこ？
literalMeaning: Now, where?
usageNote: Very casual. Best with friends or people you are close to.

japanese: 今向かってる！
kana: いま むかってる！
literalMeaning: I'm heading there now!
usageNote: Natural casual texting with friends.

japanese: またあとで！
kana: また あとで！
literalMeaning: Again, later!
usageNote: Friendly and casual.

japanese: メッセージありがとう！
kana: メッセージ ありがとう！
literalMeaning: Message, thanks!
usageNote: Casual and friendly for messages or social media.

japanese: 返信遅くなってごめん！
kana: へんしん おそくなって ごめん！
literalMeaning: Sorry that the reply became late!
usageNote: Natural casual message to a friend.

japanese: 助けてください。
kana: たすけて ください。
literalMeaning: Please help.
usageNote: Direct and appropriate when you genuinely need help.

japanese: 警察を呼んでください。
kana: けいさつを よんで ください。
literalMeaning: Please call the police.
usageNote: Emergency phrase.

japanese: 医者が必要です。
kana: いしゃが ひつようです。
literalMeaning: A doctor is necessary.
usageNote: Clear emergency/medical phrase.
